rationale: First direct check for the accepted obligation c-client-request-completes-on-inactive-raft (unit unit-c-client-request-completes-on-inactive-raft). It fixes one discriminator for the requirement: after Shutdown().Error() has returned, so that run, runFSM and runSnapshots have exited and no writer remains, client requests are issued against the inactive node and their completion is counted. The harness exercises the default-configuration instance (VerifyLeader, whose channel is created with 64 slots) and the documented-option instance (Apply with BatchApplyCh, which buffers applyCh), reports raw per-path counts and the total, and uses a third default-configured node as a diagnostic control where the same select structure has an unbuffered channel. The plan records the state of the fixed inputs, the binding that locates the representative select, the oracle (the asserted field is the number of owed completions, not a proxy value), the schedule and permanence limits, and what remains outside the prefix.
